_about: John Preston (1587-1628, Puritan master of Emmanuel College, Cambridge, and preacher at Lincoln's Inn), for the Word Hoard: NOTHING SHELVED. IA holds his treatises only in 17th-century printings; seven Princeton scans were fetched on 2026-10-02 and their OCR scored 79-81% (one more was refused by the identity gate), too poor to shelve. They are listed under _pending with their identifiers. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of his work. Added by lane A, round 7 (my pick). No uids minted.
